description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigHelper class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides utility methods for retrieving, setting, and deleting configuration values in the database, specifically from the 'hs_hr_config' table. It leverages Doctrine DBAL for database interactions and includes methods to abstract connection handling and schema management.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A utility class for interacting with configuration data stored in the database's 'hs_hr_config' table. Provides methods to get, set, and delete configuration values, ensuring schema compatibility and connection management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConfigHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection, either from the provided connection or by calling the static method.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Obtains the schema manager to introspect database table details.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specific configuration setting from the 'hs_hr_config' table.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates a configuration value in the 'hs_hr_config' table.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a configuration setting from the 'hs_hr_config' table.
